sahneler.metin: At America's tallest dam, the main spillway broke apart.
Within days, nearly one hundred ninety thousand people were ordered to evacuate.
A hole had opened in the concrete chute.
Water was getting underneath the thin slab.
The emergency spillway was used for the first time.
Its hillside began eroding toward the top.
California rebuilt both spillways and reviewed its dam safety practices.

aciklama:
Oroville forced the evacuation of nearly 190,000 people. The cause: uplift and erosion under a thin, poorly drained concrete spillway slab.
